canonical_project: Quantum Switch Tamasuk DMM-A data center (SPARK campus)
owner: Quantum Switch Tamasuk (Tamasuk Holding / Quantum Switch)
notes: QST's first Saudi data center is located inside King Salman Energy Park (SPARK), described by DCD as a 50-sq-km site outside Abqaiq (Buqayq governorate) about 70 km south of Dammam. Tamasuk's official financing release (Natixis CIB) says the SPARK data centre reached commercial operation Q4 2022; project-finance coverage cites 7.5 MW for this first site. DataCenterMap lists DMM-A as operational carrier-neutral at SPARK.
